title: calamus erectus var. schizospathus
intro: Calamus erectus var. schizospathus, commonly known as Acorus calamus var. schizospathus, is a plant species that belongs to the family Acoraceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat digestive issues, stress, and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Acorus calamus var. schizospathus include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and relieve muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, such as camphor, borneol, and borneol acetate, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
